name: session-coach
description: Suggests /clear when a prompt starts a new task, and budgets workflow agents.

clearHintMinContextPercent.title: Clear hint: minimum context percent
clearHintMinContextPercent.description: Only suggest /clear when the context window is at least this percent full.

idleMinutes.title: Clear hint: idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: A prompt sent after this many idle minutes counts as a new task without asking a model.

useModelCheck.title: Clear hint: ask a small model
useModelCheck.description: Ask a small model (haiku) whether a prompt starts a new task. Costs one short call per checked prompt.

workflowAgentCap.title: Workflow agent cap
workflowAgentCap.description: Most agents one workflow run may start. 0 means no cap.
